seams.description: CI3 HTTP route, session, redirect, rendered DOM and user-visible response
Database state reconciled after a real HTTP request
Uploaded/generated/downloaded file bytes, headers, rows and cells
Email/SMS request captured by loopback stub; production transport remains blocked
Same fixture and request profile with latency, memory and query-plan evidence
Fixture cleanup, database restore and source/runtime integrity

cases.title: Reconcile all 178 explicit routes
cases.given: Pinned CI3 source and synthetic users
cases.when: Enumerate every configured route pattern with representative parameters
cases.expected_ci3: Every route classified as reachable, redirect, validation response or approved legacy defect; unclassified=0
cases.ci4_disposition: Explicit route or approved retirement; Auto Routing Legacy remains disabled
cases.comparator: route pattern, target, method, HTTP status, redirect and DOM signature

cases.title: Discover implicit/default-route entry points
cases.given: Public methods from 23 controllers and three synthetic roles
cases.when: Probe controller/method URLs absent from explicit routes
cases.expected_ci3: Reachable and unreachable implicit entries recorded with role and branch effects; unknown=0
cases.ci4_disposition: Create explicit route only for approved live entry; retire or deny remaining entries
cases.comparator: HTTP status, redirect, handler identity and side-effect delta

cases.title: Missing URL reproduces broken CI3 404
cases.given: Unknown synthetic URL
cases.when: GET missing route as anonymous and authenticated user
cases.expected_ci3: HTTP 200 with Error-controller collision warning
cases.ci4_disposition: CORRECT_AND_REBASELINE to real HTTP 404 without warning or login form
cases.comparator: status, warning signature, body layout and redirect

cases.title: Known broken route aliases
cases.given: Representative route parameters
cases.when: Open rackstatus, book page 2 and two-parameter report aliases
cases.expected_ci3: Broken target or repeated $1 behavior captured exactly
cases.ci4_disposition: Correct or retire only with Business/QA route decision
cases.comparator: resolved target, status, redirect and rendered result

cases.title: Legacy Report Tracking Test consolidation
cases.given: Authenticated central user
cases.when: Open ReportTrackingListingTest with empty, single, multiple and malformed status filters
cases.expected_ci3: HTTP 200; empty or malformed input omits the status filter; valid integer IDs filter through Query Builder without raw IN SQL
cases.ci4_disposition: CONSOLIDATE into the single ReportTrackingListing page; preserve corrected filter behavior; do not create or expose a Test route/page/menu in CI4
cases.comparator: HTTP result, rendered rows, SQL error absence, corrected filter parity and absence of a CI4 Test route/page/menu

cases.title: Valid login establishes CI3 session contract
cases.given: Active central user with runtime-only test password
cases.expected_ci3: Redirect /dashboard; eight session keys set; one tbl_last_login row added
cases.ci4_disposition: PRESERVE visible contract; add session regeneration as approved security correction
cases.comparator: redirect, session keys and login-history row

cases.title: Invalid and deleted users cannot login
cases.given: Wrong password, unknown username and deleted user
cases.expected_ci3: Return or redirect to login with mismatch message; no session and no login-history row
cases.ci4_disposition: PRESERVE semantic result with generic error and throttling
cases.comparator: redirect, message class, session absence and DB no-change

cases.title: Protected route, timeout and logout behavior
cases.given: Anonymous, active and expired sessions
cases.expected_ci3: Anonymous/expired returns login; logout destroys session and redirects login
cases.ci4_disposition: PRESERVE result; use explicit POST logout and secure session policy after approval
cases.comparator: status, redirect, cookie/session state

cases.title: Password-reset request contract
cases.given: Known synthetic email and accepting email stub
cases.expected_ci3: Activation row inserted and one reset email attempted; redirect with visible result
cases.ci4_disposition: PRESERVE workflow; remove hardcoded CC and use secure token
cases.comparator: DB row, redacted recipient, subject/body semantic fields and redirect

cases.title: Unknown, invalid, old and reused reset tokens
cases.given: Unknown email, invalid token, old token and previously used token
cases.when: Run request, confirm and password-create paths
cases.expected_ci3: Unknown/invalid denied; old token remains accepted because CI3 has no TTL; successful reset deletes all email tokens
cases.ci4_disposition: CORRECT_AND_REBASELINE old/reused token to deny with TTL and single use
cases.comparator: redirect, user password delta, reset-token rows and outbound attempt count

cases.title: User list/add/edit/delete matrix
cases.given: Central and branch-scoped users
cases.when: List, add valid user, edit fields and soft-delete created user through HTTP routes
cases.expected_ci3: Listing scope and validation messages captured; insert/update succeeds; delete sets isDeleted=1
cases.ci4_disposition: PRESERVE business result and soft-delete semantic
cases.comparator: DOM rows, validation, DB before/after and redirect/JSON

cases.title: User validation and duplicate email
cases.given: Missing fields, duplicate email, short mobile and mismatched passwords
cases.expected_ci3: Field errors and true/false email-existence response; no unintended DB write
cases.ci4_disposition: PRESERVE semantic validation; JSON contract may replace raw echo with paired UI change
cases.comparator: field errors, endpoint payload and DB no-change

cases.title: Change-password outcomes
cases.given: Correct old password, wrong old password and same replacement password
cases.expected_ci3: Correct changes hash; wrong denied; same password reports fail because affected_rows=0
cases.ci4_disposition: Business/QA decide whether same-password result is preserved or corrected
cases.comparator: message, password hash delta and session state

cases.title: Login history and AJAX branch/book lists
cases.given: Authenticated central and branch users
cases.when: Open login history and call branch/book cascade endpoints
cases.expected_ci3: Paginated history plus raw select/input HTML matching branch fixture
cases.ci4_disposition: PRESERVE visible values; escape output and formalize endpoint contract
cases.comparator: DOM values, pagination and HTML fragment semantic equality

cases.title: Anonymous and role direct-route matrix
cases.given: Anonymous and role 1/2/3 sessions
cases.expected_ci3: Anonymous denied; all positive roles commonly pass because isAdmin gate is inert
cases.ci4_disposition: Security/Business-approved route policy replaces inert gate; no accidental privilege loss or gain
cases.comparator: route × role allow/deny matrix and side-effect absence

cases.title: Branch listing and direct-object isolation
cases.given: Operator A in branch 1 and Operator B in branch 2
cases.when: List, view, edit and delete own/cross-branch objects
cases.expected_ci3: Per-query scope and known IDOR gaps recorded without using real data
cases.ci4_disposition: CORRECT_AND_REBASELINE cross-branch access to deny; Security sign-off required
cases.comparator: DOM visibility, HTTP result and DB delta per branch

cases.title: Order listings for statuses 1 through 8
cases.given: One or more synthetic orders for every legacy status
cases.when: Open all queue/listing routes as central and branch users
cases.expected_ci3: Rows, counts, search, pagination and status-6 visibility match literal fixture matrix
cases.ci4_disposition: PRESERVE approved queue and branch behavior
cases.comparator: ordered row IDs, counts, pagination and branch scope

cases.title: Create valid repair order
cases.given: Operator A, valid masters, accepting SMS stub and generated safe image
cases.expected_ci3: One status-1 order, one action-1 status log and one SMS attempt; visible redirect/result captured
cases.ci4_disposition: PRESERVE result; make tracking ID allocation atomic and uploads safe
cases.comparator: order/log rows, generated ID format, file effect, outbound payload and redirect

cases.title: Create-order validation and upload rejection
cases.given: Missing masters/required fields, malformed upload and duplicate input
cases.expected_ci3: Validation/error behavior captured; no partial order/log write for rejected input
cases.ci4_disposition: PRESERVE accepted business rules; strengthen upload validation
cases.comparator: field errors, DB/file no-change and outbound attempts=0

cases.title: Normal status lifecycle 1 to 5
cases.given: Orders at statuses 1,2,3,4
cases.expected_ci3: Status, provider, date fields and status_log rows match transition table
cases.ci4_disposition: PRESERVE approved transitions and make each mutation transactional
cases.comparator: exact status/date/provider/log delta and visible result

cases.title: Direct invalid transition and partial batch failure
cases.given: Direct POST status outside UI choices and mixed valid/invalid batch IDs
cases.expected_ci3: Backend accepts arbitrary status and may partially write batch; exact rows captured
cases.ci4_disposition: Business/Security decide server-side state machine; partial write must be corrected transactionally
cases.comparator: per-row state/log delta and failure position

cases.title: Edit, print and soft-delete order
cases.given: Existing branch-1 order
cases.when: Open print, edit non-status fields and delete
cases.expected_ci3: Print renders; edit preserves status/log; delete sets action_status=8 without new log
cases.ci4_disposition: PRESERVE approved semantic while closing cross-branch IDOR
cases.comparator: print DOM, order field diff and status_log no-change

cases.title: Concurrent tracking-ID allocation
cases.given: Two simultaneous synthetic create requests
cases.when: Release both requests at same barrier
cases.expected_ci3: Observe whether select_max+1 creates duplicate/collision; no hypothesis counted as result
cases.ci4_disposition: CORRECT_AND_REBASELINE with DB uniqueness and atomic allocation
cases.comparator: request outcomes, unique track IDs, order/log counts and SMS attempts

cases.title: Known tracking ID in English and Thai
cases.given: WP00C-TRACK-005 with four status-log rows
cases.when: Open EN and TH tracking form/result routes
cases.expected_ci3: Language-specific headings and timeline of four rows render without customer PII
cases.ci4_disposition: PRESERVE content/order/date contract and remove global temp table
cases.comparator: status, normalized DOM, language strings and ordered timeline

cases.title: Unknown and malformed tracking IDs
cases.given: Unknown, empty, wildcard-like and oversized identifiers
cases.expected_ci3: Validation/not-found behavior and partial LIKE matching captured
cases.ci4_disposition: Preserve approved lookup semantic; bind query input
cases.comparator: validation, not-found DOM and returned tracking IDs

cases.title: Parallel public tracking isolation
cases.given: Two different synthetic tracking IDs
cases.expected_ci3: Measure cross-request contamination caused by shared temp_status_log
cases.ci4_disposition: CORRECT_AND_REBASELINE to per-request query with zero contamination
cases.comparator: each response timeline and temp-table/interleaving evidence

cases.title: Valid English and Thai contact submission
cases.given: Synthetic contact values and accepting email stub
cases.expected_ci3: One contact row and one email attempt per submission; language result captured
cases.ci4_disposition: PRESERVE business result; config from environment and redacted audit
cases.comparator: contact row, outbound payload semantic fields and DOM result

cases.title: Contact validation, SMTP failure and duplicate submit
cases.given: Invalid form, rejecting/timeout stub and replayed valid request
cases.expected_ci3: Validation and DB/email partial-side-effect behavior captured exactly
cases.ci4_disposition: Define idempotency and recoverable delivery-intent contract; no duplicate send
cases.comparator: DB rows, attempt count, stub request IDs and user-visible result

cases.title: Back-office contact listing
cases.given: Central and two branch users
cases.when: Open contactListing and search synthetic detail
cases.expected_ci3: All authenticated users can see global contact list; branch scope absent
cases.ci4_disposition: Business/Security decide approved visibility and re-baseline
cases.comparator: route × role/branch visibility, search and pagination

cases.title: Rating page redirect defect
cases.given: Valid synthetic tracking ID
cases.expected_ci3: Redirect occurs before rating view renders
cases.ci4_disposition: Business/QA decide corrected public rating-page contract
cases.comparator: status, location and DOM absence

cases.title: First valid rating closes status-5 order
cases.given: Unrated status-5 synthetic order and eight scores
cases.expected_ci3: Eight rating rows, one comment and order status 5 to 7 with completion dates; no status log
cases.ci4_disposition: PRESERVE approved side effects in one transaction
cases.comparator: rating/comment rows and exact order/log delta

cases.title: Duplicate, invalid and unknown rating
cases.given: Already-rated order, invalid score set and unknown track ID
cases.expected_ci3: Duplicate/invalid/unknown outcomes captured with no extra accepted side effects
cases.ci4_disposition: PRESERVE rule and validate score range server-side
cases.comparator: messages, rating/comment/order/log row deltas

cases.title: Status, Price and New Order preview
cases.given: Three generated synthetic XLSX fixtures
cases.expected_ci3: Approved rendered preview, valid/reject rows and temp-table deltas; confirm/message attempts=0
cases.ci4_disposition: PRESERVE approved output without PHPExcel warnings
cases.comparator: HTTP/DOM, workbook fixture hash and temp-table rows

cases.title: Status, Price and New Order confirm success
cases.given: Approved previews on isolated synthetic DB
cases.expected_ci3: Approved order/status/price/log deltas including known New Order redirect warning
cases.ci4_disposition: PRESERVE data result; correct warning and redirect failure
cases.comparator: HTTP/DOM plus exact accepted/rejected/order/log rows

cases.title: Malformed, mixed-validity and empty import files
cases.given: Wrong extension, malformed workbook, invalid headers, mixed rows and empty workbook
cases.expected_ci3: Validation/reject behavior and any partial temp/final writes captured
cases.ci4_disposition: Reject unsafe/malformed input before business write; preserve approved row mapping
cases.comparator: validation DOM, accepted/rejected counts, temp/final rows and file cleanup

cases.title: Confirm replay and idempotency baseline
cases.given: One approved batch
cases.expected_ci3: Status/New Order duplicate writes and stable Price assignment reproduced
cases.ci4_disposition: CORRECT_AND_REBASELINE to idempotent success with no additional writes
cases.comparator: request count, response and per-table row/value deltas

cases.title: Parallel import users and batch isolation
cases.given: Operator A/B sessions with distinct batches
cases.when: Overlap and then simultaneously release preview/confirm requests
cases.expected_ci3: Controlled overwrite defect plus simultaneous-request result captured without speculation
cases.ci4_disposition: CORRECT_AND_REBASELINE with batch ID, owner and atomic confirm
cases.comparator: batch ownership, temp/final rows and cross-user contamination

cases.title: Tokenless Confirm baseline
cases.given: Valid batch with and without CSRF token
cases.expected_ci3: Token absent and tokenless POST accepted
cases.ci4_disposition: CORRECT_AND_REBASELINE to reject before DB write
cases.comparator: form token, HTTP result and DB delta

cases.title: Parameterized CRUD matrix for ten master controllers
cases.given: Central and branch users plus two rows per master
cases.when: Run list/add/edit/delete and invalid-form variants for every controller
cases.expected_ci3: Route-specific validation, redirect, pagination and hard-delete effects captured
cases.ci4_disposition: PRESERVE approved business values; correct unsafe authorization/CSRF separately
cases.comparator: DOM/JSON, row values, counts, cdate/udate and referenced-object effects

cases.title: Referenced master deletion and duplicate values
cases.given: Master values referenced by synthetic orders/import mapping
cases.when: Submit duplicates and delete referenced rows
cases.expected_ci3: Hard delete/orphan and duplicate acceptance behavior captured
cases.ci4_disposition: Business/DBA decision required before adding constraints or soft delete
cases.comparator: master/order/report/import before-after and orphan counts

cases.title: Branch-type image upload validation
cases.given: Valid PNG and disguised invalid file
cases.expected_ci3: Legacy extension/path/file behavior captured without executing uploaded content
cases.ci4_disposition: CORRECT_AND_REBASELINE to validated non-executable storage
cases.comparator: HTTP result, DB filename, file bytes/location and execution-deny check

cases.title: Menu group listing/add/edit and sidebar effect
cases.given: Central/branch menu groups and four synthetic menu entries
cases.when: List/add/edit group and reopen sidebar under each GroupID
cases.expected_ci3: CSV group_type drives visible menus; pagination miscount and no-menu selection captured
cases.ci4_disposition: Preserve approved visibility; fix count bug through explicit decision
cases.comparator: group row, sidebar link set and pagination

cases.title: Background CMS DB/file behavior
cases.given: Synthetic background record, valid PNG and alternate extension
cases.expected_ci3: DB writes and fixed filenames occur while public views ignore DB; extension mismatch captured
cases.ci4_disposition: Business decides DB-driven correction or retained fixed-file contract
cases.comparator: DB row, file set, public DOM/style references and delete residue

cases.title: Dashboard totals and branch background
cases.given: Literal order/status/branch matrix
cases.when: Open dashboard as central and branch users
cases.expected_ci3: Counts and branch/default background match fixture literals
cases.ci4_disposition: PRESERVE approved totals and scope
cases.comparator: labels, exact counts, links and background reference

cases.title: All HTML reports with filter matrix
cases.given: Two branches, statuses 1-8, two brand/type pairs and rating literals
cases.when: Run every report for all/branch/date/status filters
cases.expected_ci3: Rows, percentages, totals and branch scope equal approved fixture literals
cases.ci4_disposition: PRESERVE exact business totals while replacing raw SQL with binding
cases.comparator: exact ordered rows, totals, percentages and hidden branch values

cases.title: Tracking-detail report
cases.given: Literal order/status/date matrix
cases.expected_ci3: All matching rows and TotalDay/CMGTotalDay values captured; no real pagination
cases.ci4_disposition: Business decides visible pagination; exact result set remains approved baseline
cases.comparator: ordered IDs, calculated day values, total count and route parameter behavior

cases.title: Tracking summary and missing-master join
cases.given: Eight normal orders and one order referencing missing brand/type
cases.expected_ci3: Missing-master order is omitted by INNER JOIN; exact summary totals recorded
cases.ci4_disposition: Business/DBA approve preserve or correction before changing join
cases.comparator: row IDs, omissions, totals and pagination

cases.title: All report exports
cases.given: Same approved report filters and fixture version
cases.when: Download rating, in-progress and tracking exports
cases.expected_ci3: Headers, filename, row order, cell strings and totals captured from HTML-as-XLS output
cases.ci4_disposition: Preserve approved file contract until separate format modernization
cases.comparator: HTTP headers, filename, byte-normalized table, ordered cells and totals

cases.title: Empty, invalid-date, unauthorized and large report inputs
cases.given: Empty range, malformed date, cross-branch filter and generated volume profile
cases.expected_ci3: Legacy empty/date/scope behavior plus p50/p95, memory, query count and plan captured
cases.ci4_disposition: No data leak; totals exact; performance no worse than approved budget
cases.comparator: HTTP/result totals, unauthorized rows=0, latency/memory/query-plan profile

cases.title: Email payload/failure contract
cases.given: Loopback stub success/reject/timeout/duplicate states
cases.when: Run password-reset and contact email-producing flows
cases.expected_ci3: Redacted payload, attempt count, DB effect and visible failure mapping captured
cases.ci4_disposition: Environment credentials, idempotent delivery intent, retry/manual recovery and redacted audit
cases.comparator: recipient class, subject/body semantic fields, request ID, attempts and DB/HTTP effects

cases.title: SMS payload/failure contract
cases.given: Loopback stub success/reject/timeout/duplicate states
cases.when: Run order-create/status flows that request SMS
cases.expected_ci3: Message variants, attempt count and user/DB behavior captured without real send
cases.ci4_disposition: Environment credentials, duplicate prevention, timeout mapping and redacted audit
cases.comparator: message semantic text, request ID, attempts and order/log effects

cases.title: CI3 production-like NFR baseline
cases.given: Approved sanitized volume profile and fixed request mix
cases.expected_ci3: p50/p95, throughput, memory, 5xx, query count/plan and restore timing recorded
cases.ci4_disposition: Freeze final budget before DB/CI4 comparison; no unapproved regression
cases.comparator: same profile, dataset, environment identity and metric formulas

cases.title: Fixture cleanup and isolated restore
cases.given: Isolated empty database, seeded kit and completed test run
cases.when: Run cleanup/restore and full schema verification
cases.expected_ci3: Database returns to zero rows or sealed restore point; generated files removed; CI3 source SHA/worktree unchanged
cases.ci4_disposition: Same deterministic setup/teardown contract retained for all comparisons
cases.comparator: row counts, file manifest, source SHA/dirty count, backup ID and verification result
